## Derivation

For every odd residue r modulo 2^k I independently generated the accelerated trajectory rather than guessing exponent strings. At each step e_j was computed as the exact 2-adic valuation of 3x_(j-1)+1 and x_j=(3x_(j-1)+1)/2^e_j. In parallel I maintained A_0=1, B_0=0, D_0=1 and A_j=3A_(j-1), B_j=3B_(j-1)+D_(j-1), D_j=2^e_j D_(j-1). Exhaustive checks found zero violations of D_j x_j=A_j r+B_j across every enumerated prefix.

A prefix was retained exactly when k>=1+sum(e), A<D, and B<(D-A)r. For every retained prefix the representative endpoint satisfies x_s<r; exhaustive checks found zero descent, affine-identity, or stability-condition violations in the (8,4), (10,6), (12,8), and (14,10) enumerations.

The all-members implication also follows algebraically. If n=r+t2^k and k>=E_s+1, then before the jth division the perturbation relative to the base trajectory is divisible by at least 2^(e_j+1), so adding it cannot alter the exact base valuation e_j. Induction therefore preserves the exponent sequence and gives C^s(n)=(A_s n+B_s)/D_s. Since A_s<D_s and B_s<(D_s-A_s)r, one has (D_s-A_s)n-B_s>0 for every t>=0, hence C^s(n)<n.
